units.source_text: 葬礼当天，许多人前来吊唁。

en.t: On the day of the funeral, many people came to offer their condolences.

units.source_text: 接待最繁忙的时候，我忽然感觉鼻血从鼻孔里流淌下来。

en.t: At the busiest moment of receiving guests, I suddenly felt blood flowing down from my nostril.

units.source_text: 我吓了一跳，连忙用腰带的一端把鼻孔堵住，

en.t: Startled, I hurriedly plugged my nostril with one end of my sash,

units.source_text: 然后就这么光着脚丫，踩着踏石飞跑到庭院里，

en.t: and then, still barefoot, I raced across the stepping stones into the garden,

units.source_text: 躲藏在人眼看不见的树荫底下，仰卧在一块三尺高的大点景石上，等待血止。

en.t: hid beneath the shade of a tree where no one could see me, lay on my back on a large ornamental stone about three feet high, and waited for the bleeding to stop.

units.source_text: 耀眼的阳光透过老橡树叶的间罅筛落下来，可以望见片片细碎的蓝天。

en.t: Dazzling sunlight filtered down through gaps in the old oak leaves, and I could see small broken patches of blue sky.

units.source_text: 对我来说，流鼻血是生来头一遭。

en.t: For me, having a nosebleed was a first in my life.

units.source_text: 这鼻血告诉我：那是由于祖父亡故，我心灵受到创伤。

en.t: This nosebleed told me that my grandfather's death had wounded my heart.
The household was in complete disorder.

units.source_text: 我是唯一的家属，必须同人们酬酢；

en.t: I was the only family member and had to deal courteously with the people who came;

units.source_text: 而葬礼的事千头万绪，压根儿没闲暇去过多考虑，

en.t: and the funeral involved so many matters that I had no time at all to think deeply,

units.source_text: 也就一直没有沉下心来思索祖父的死和我自己今后的着落。

en.t: so I had never settled down to consider my grandfather's death or where my own life would go from then on.

units.source_text: 我从未想过自己是脆弱的。

en.t: I had never thought of myself as fragile.

units.source_text: 我几乎是无意识地飞跑了出来，因为不想让别人看到自己的脆弱形象。

en.t: I had run out almost unconsciously because I did not want others to see me looking so weak.

units.source_text: 我心里想道：自己是丧主，临出殡前，这样失态，一来对不起大家，二来会引起一些骚乱。

en.t: I thought to myself: I am the chief mourner, and losing composure like this just before the funeral procession would be unfair to everyone and would also cause some commotion.

units.source_text: 祖父辞世后第三天，我第一次有了自己安静的时间，仰卧在点景石上。

en.t: On the third day after my grandfather passed away, I had my first quiet time to myself, lying on my back on the ornamental stone.

units.source_text: 此时此刻，自己已孑然一身，一种无依无靠的悲凉思绪隐隐约约地涌上了心头。

en.t: At that very moment, I felt that I was already utterly alone, and a vague, desolate sadness of having no one to depend on rose in my heart.
